SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.name, s.theme, s.latitude, s.longitude,
ROUND(CAST( ST_Distance( s.location::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography ) / 1000.0 AS numeric ), 2)
NULL::numeric
AS distance_km, COALESCE(s.bookmark_count, 0) AS bookmark_count, s.status, sa.created_at AS saved_at, s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS deleted FROM saved_spot_archives sa JOIN spots s ON s.id = sa.spot_id WHERE sa.user_id = #{userId} AND sa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sa.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_spot_archives sa JOIN spots s ON s.id = sa.spot_id WHERE sa.user_id = #{userId} AND sa.deleted_at IS NULL
